vector<int> sieve(int n) {
    vector<int> a(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        a[i] = 1;
    }
    for (int i = 2; i <= sqrt(n); i++) {
        if (a[i] == 1) {
            for (int k = 2; i * k <= n; k++) {
                a[i * k] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return a;
}

vector<int> gd(int a, int b) {
    int m = (int)gcd(a, b);
    vector<int> q;
    for (int i = 1; i * i <= m; ++i) {
        if (m % i == 0) {
            q.push_back(i);
            if (i != m / i) {
                q.push_back(m / i);
            }
        }
    }
    return q;
}

int divisors(int n, int m) {
    if (n - (m + (m * m)) >= 0) {
        return m;
    }
    for (int i = (int)sqrt(m); i >= 1; i--) {
        if (m % i == 0 && n - (m + (m * i)) >= 0) {
            return i;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

        res += val / pow(k, p);

    return res >= t;

    while (start <= end) {

        if (a[mid] >= v) {
            ans = mid;
            end = mid - 1;
        } else if (a[mid] < v) {
            start = mid + 1;

    }
    return ans;

        bool dec = false, neg = false;
        int start = 0;
        if (x[0] == '-') {
            neg = true;
            start = 1;
        }
        for (int i = start; i < x.size(); i++) {
            if (x[i] == '.') {

                dec = true;
            } else if (dec) {
                f *= 10;
                res += (x[i] - '0') / f;
            } else {
                res = res * 10 + (x[i] - '0');
            }
        }
        return res * (neg ? -1 : 1);
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());

    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
